whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dental Foundation,

I noticed your clinic has strong 4.3★ reviews in Rajendra Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, treatment menu, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dentalfoundation

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dental Foundation team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic (Dental Foundation in Rajendra Nagar, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first appointment booking and patient care highlights for your practice in Rajendra Nagar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
